pokedex.106: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.
pokedex.107: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.
pokedex.108: It checks out whatever’s around it by licking everything. If you don’t clean off a spot where it’s licked you, you’ll break out in a rash!
pokedex.109: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
pokedex.110: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.
pokedex.111: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.
pokedex.112: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.
pokedex.113: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.
pokedex.114: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. Its vines shake as it walks.
pokedex.115: Kangaskhan’s maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
pokedex.117: Capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.
pokedex.118: When the weather grows warm, they form groups and swim upriver. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that spring has arrived.
pokedex.119: When the weather grows cold, its whole body flushes a deep red. This sight serves as a poetic reminder that autumn has arrived.
pokedex.120: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.
pokedex.121: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.
pokedex.122: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
pokedex.123: It confuses its prey with its quick, ninja-like movements. Then, in an instant, it cleaves them with its scythes.
pokedex.124: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
pokedex.125: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.
pokedex.126: When it’s tired, it leaps into the mouth of a volcano and soaks its body in magma to ease its weariness. Its body burns at 2,192 degrees F.
pokedex.127: It grips its prey in its pincers and splits them apart. Although it is a powerful Pokémon, it can’t deal with the cold.
pokedex.128: Historically, people in areas all over the world have ridden Tauros, but the practice is said to have started in Alola.
pokedex.129: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you’ll soon grow tired of seeing them.
pokedex.130: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.
pokedex.131: Its high intelligence enables it to comprehend human speech. When it’s in a good mood, it sings in its beautiful voice.
pokedex.132: It can reorganize its cells to make itself into a duplicate of anything it sees. The quality of the duplicate depends on the individual.
pokedex.133: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.
pokedex.134: Its cells are composed of units much like water molecules. It lives close to water and is often mistaken for a mermaid.
pokedex.135: They send out electrical charges of about 10,000 volts. Because they are high-strung, it can be difficult to grow close to them.
pokedex.136: When it catches prey or finds berries, it breathes fire on them until they’re well done, and then it gobbles them up.
pokedex.137: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.
pokedex.138: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.
pokedex.139: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It’s apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.
pokedex.140: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It’s said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.
pokedex.141: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn’t adapt in time and went extinct.
pokedex.142: A Pokémon from the age of the dinosaurs. It used its sawlike fangs to shred its prey before eating them.
pokedex.143: Its stomach is said to be incomparably strong. Even Muk’s poison is nothing more than a hint of spice on Snorlax’s tongue.
pokedex.144: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.
pokedex.145: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.
pokedex.146: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.
pokedex.147: It grows by molting repeatedly. Boots made from the tanned cast-off skin are a super luxury item.
pokedex.148: It has long been thought that its crystalline orbs are imbued with the power to control the weather.
pokedex.149: This Pokémon saved a shipwrecked man, taking him to a remote island—a paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.
pokedex.150: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
pokedex.151: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
pokedex.152: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.
pokedex.153: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
pokedex.155: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
pokedex.156: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
pokedex.158: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.
pokedex.160: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
pokedex.161: A very cautious POKéMON, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
pokedex.162: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other POKéMON to enter.
pokedex.163: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.
pokedex.164: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it “the emperor of dark nights.”
pokedex.165: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.
pokedex.166: While it’s believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.
pokedex.167: It waits intently until its preferred prey, Cutiefly, gets caught in its web. In fact, it’s quite a patient Pokémon.
pokedex.168: There are some areas where people use the string Ariados spins for their own weaving. The resulting cloth is popular for its strength.
pokedex.169: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.
pokedex.170: Its two antennae were originally fins. It discharges electricity to stun its prey before attacking.
pokedex.171: Should you peer into the ocean at night and see a light shining like the stars, that is Lanturn.
pokedex.172: It is not yet skilled at controlling electricity. If you take your eyes off it, it may shock itself.
pokedex.173: On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.
pokedex.174: It likes to sing but is not yet good at it. With praise and encouragement, it will get better little by little.
pokedex.176: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
pokedex.177: Although it still can’t fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.
pokedex.178: It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.
pokedex.179: Clothing made from Mareep’s fleece is easily charged with static electricity, so a special process is used on it.
pokedex.180: In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.
pokedex.181: The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.
pokedex.183: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.
pokedex.184: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast- moving rivers.
pokedex.185: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.
pokedex.186: They gather on moonlit nights to form a large chorus. Their cries sound angry and not at all pleasant, but they are certainly distinctive.
pokedex.190: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.
pokedex.191: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.
pokedex.192: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.
pokedex.193: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
pokedex.194: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
pokedex.195: This carefree POKéMON has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.
pokedex.196: It can instantaneously sense its opponent’s movements by feeling air currents with its fine fur.
pokedex.197: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent’s eyes.
pokedex.198: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, “Get home before the Murkrow fly.”
pokedex.199: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
pokedex.200: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.
pokedex.201: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
pokedex.202: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to pump up its counterstrike.
pokedex.203: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.
pokedex.204: Motionless, it hangs from trees, waiting for its bug Pokémon prey to come to it. Its favorite in Alola is Cutiefly.
pokedex.205: When something approaches it, it fires off fragments of its steel shell in attack. This is not a conscious action but a conditioned reflex.
pokedex.206: It travels by digging through the ground. Diglett and Dunsparce share one another’s tunnels happily.
pokedex.207: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
pokedex.208: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.
pokedex.209: Despite its intimidating face, it’s quite cowardly. Its desperate attempts to appear threatening make it popular with people.
pokedex.210: Its well-developed lower jaw and heavy fangs are its weapons. As long as it’s not provoked, it rarely bites.
pokedex.212: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.
pokedex.213: The BERRIES it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.
pokedex.214: It’s proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it’s always fighting with.
pokedex.215: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
